scenario: Adjacent simulation ticks share a bounded immutable checkpoint while uncommitted mutations and reads retain their ordered durability fence. Queue or reward-history pressure forces an earlier flush; bounded catch-up batches can cover more ticks.
coverage: The grouped-tick regression bounds checkpoint count by ceil(ticks/2)+2 and reopens the latest authority tick after shutdown.
Storage failure withholds acknowledgment; slow writers fence replies and bounded request admission.
Body snapshots, clock credit, completed travel, and ordered delivered control retain their admission prefix.
Queued intervals survive storage resume, delayed casts, shared-player pressure, and long writer stalls.
limitations: No new battle result establishes reduced pauses or expiry yet.
The storage writer still pauses authority when its existing two-copy bound fills.
Physical storage tail latency remains part of the measured operating envelope.

consumer_build.scope: Linux comparison checkout plus retained own patches; not a host deployment from current main.
